definitions.short: Ammiel , the name of three or four Israelites
definitions.full: H5988. Ammiel עַמִּיאֵל proper name, masculine ( my kinsman is God , Gray Prop. N. 254 ); — ᵐ5 Αμος ( με ) ιηλ : 1 east Jordan name 2Sam 9:4-5 , 17:27 . 2 a Danite Num 13:12 (P). 3 David's father-in-law 1Chr 3:5 (= אֱלִיעָם 2Sam 11:3 ). 4 son of Obed Edom 1Chr 26:5 .

occurrences.englishText: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
The king said to him, “Where is he?”
Then king David sent, and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.
When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
